|colspan="7" align="left"|<small>'''Notes:'''</small>{{refbegin}}{{note|immunity-e|<small>1</small>}} <small>After switching tribes, Jean-Luc and Ludivine were given individual immunity at the following Tribal Council should their new tribe lose the<br />corresponding Immunity Challenge.</small><br />{{note|ambassadors-e|<small>2</small>}} <small>At the ambassadors meeting, Jérôme and Julie did not agree on a castaway to eliminate, therefore both of them drew rocks. Jérôme lost<br />the draw and was eliminated from the game.</small><br />{{note|necklace-e|<small>3</small>}} <small>A Hidden Immunity Necklace was played, however, no votes were cast against its user.</small><br />{{note|blackvote1-e|<small>4</small>}} <small>Both Sandrine and Jean-Luc's black votes did not count, as Jean-Luc was already out of the game and Bruno won the Immunity Challenge.</small><br />{{note|ring-e|<small>5</small>}} <small>Benoît had found the Golden Ring, permanently protecting him until the final five, therefore the 7 votes cast against him were negated.</small><br />{{note|blackvote2-e|<small>6</small>}} <small>Due to injury, Jesta could not compete in the Immunity Challenge, therefore she was immune and could not cast a vote at Tribal Council.<br />Béryl's black vote against her thus did not count.</small><br />{{note|jury-e|<small>7</small>}} <small>Yannick returned to France for family reasons, thus he was not a member of the jury.</small><br />{{note|elim-e|<small>8</small>}} <small>Julie came in last in the elimination challenge and was directly eliminated from the game.</small><br />{{note|blackvote3-e|<small>9</small>}} <small>Yannick's black vote did not count, as Julie was already out of the game.</small><br />{{note|tie-e|<small>10</small>}} <small> The vote resulted in a tie. Per ''Koh-Lanta'' rules, a revote would commence.</small><br />{{note|blackvote4-e|<small>11</small>}} <small>Stéphane's black vote did not count, as Freddy won the Immunity Challenge.</small><br />{{note|final5-e|<small>12</small>}} <small>At the final five, the remaining castaways competed in the orienteering challenge, where two castaways would be eliminated. Bruno and<br />Candice came in last and were eliminated.</small>{{refend}}
